scenario_text: A gas of weakly interacting particles is confined in a container held at fixed temperature. As the number density of particles is varied while temperature is kept constant, the pressure deviates from the simple proportional relationship expected for an ideal gas. Experimenters measure the equilibrium pressure across a range of densities and temperatures to characterize the correction from pairwise interactions.
